name: Competitor Agent
description: Watches your competitors' pages and pings you the day anything changes.
scheduledTask: Read each competitor page, note what changed since last time, and report only what actually matters.
examples: What changed on my competitors' sites?

settings.label: Competitor URLs
settings.help: One per line. Pricing pages are the most useful.

secrets.label: Telegram bot token
secrets.help: Optional. Message @BotFather, /newbot, paste the token. This is how the commander reports to you.

secrets.label: Telegram chat ID
secrets.help: Optional. Message your new bot, then open api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates and copy chat.id.
